cases.facts: The fictional pure function count_ascii_digits counts only ASCII characters 0 through 9. All other characters contribute zero. The input is a1b2c9.
cases.question: Using the supplied public function facts, return only the decimal count.

cases.facts: The fictional pure function normalize_crlf replaces each CR followed immediately by LF with one LF. An isolated CR is preserved. The input contains an isolated CR between letters a and b.
cases.question: Using the supplied public function facts, return only YES if the isolated CR is preserved, otherwise NO.

cases.facts: The fictional pure function parse_decimal accepts one or more ASCII decimal digits and rejects trailing junk. The input is 12x.
cases.question: Using the supplied public function facts, return only ACCEPT or REJECT.

cases.facts: The fictional pure function join_words joins input words with one ASCII space and preserves their order. The input words are red and blue.
cases.question: Using the supplied public function facts, return only the joined words.
